annotations.title: Look up one verified track record

description: Look up one verified track record by Hyperliquid vault address, vault URL or name: return, BTC over the same dates, max drawdown, Sortino, 30-day return and TVL, computed by TradingAgentStack from Hyperliquid's public API (not self-reported), with the window, the data date and a SHA-256 of the record so an agent can cite exactly what it read. On the hosted endpoint the hash also comes signed (an ES256 JWT whose public keys are published), so anyone can check later that TradingAgentStack issued that exact record. Unknown addresses come back as not_tracked with how to get verified. Not investment advice.

query.description: Vault address (0x...), app.hyperliquid.xyz/vaults/ URL or vault name
